findings.title: Disclosure becomes public certainty, then contested construction
findings.claim: The disclosure of the sleepers makes God's promise and the Hour intelligible, while the surrounding speech turns that recognized sign into competing claims over its site.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers at 18:21:4 and 18:21:23 contact 22:7's pairing of the doubt-free Hour with resurrection, while the two speech carriers at 18:21:18 and 18:21:25 contact 23:53's splitting of a common affair into parties; knowledge therefore becomes public speech that contests the response.
findings.reader_payoff: The construction proposals become the social afterlife of a disclosed sign: recognition remains real while its public meaning is immediately contested.
findings.containment: The purpose clause and the explicit mosque proposal remain intact; this does not identify the unexpressed subject of liya'lamu, decide the groups' motives, or sanctify the construction.

epistemic.reason: The candidate publication is trusted and the focus branches and word anchors are supplied, but the external connection rows provide relation-level evidence rather than target morphology.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The purpose verb at 18:21:4 and the divine elative at 18:21:23 carry knowing and superior recognition across the disclosure and its correction.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 22:7 joins the Hour's certainty to Allah raising those in the graves.
branch_activations.activation: The wider resurrection pairing gives the focus's knowledge language a public evidentiary function: the disclosed bodies make the promise intelligible while divine knowledge remains beyond the disputants.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The discovery is not only noticed; it functions as evidence through which the promise and the Hour become knowable.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not identify who the unexpressed purpose subject is or collapse human recognition into divine knowledge.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek işlem, sözü sesli olarak dışa çıkarmaktır.
branch_activations.carrier: The repeated qwl speech verbs at 18:21:18 and 18:21:25 carry the competing proposals as spoken public acts.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 23:53 depicts a common affair being split among parties that celebrate their own share.
branch_activations.activation: The focus speech verbs give the proposals public form, and the wider split-affair scene makes that speech part of factionalization rather than a neutral report of building.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The spoken proposals disclose how a recognized sign is converted into rival public claims about what should be built over it.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not assert that every speaker belongs to the same party or that the proposed mosque has a settled moral valence.

findings.title: An apparent stumble becomes directed disclosure
findings.claim: The focus's caused discovery can hold together an apparent stumble and an arranged disclosure: the hidden sleepers become public evidence even though the encounter looks accidental.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier at 18:21:2 contacts 5:107's discovery-made-public procedure; the same carrier also permits a bounded stumble image, so the encounter can appear accidental without making bodily falling the literal event.
findings.reader_payoff: The disclosure acquires a double pressure: it arrives through the appearance of chance while functioning as a vehicle of public knowledge.
findings.containment: The focus still describes a caused disclosure; no literal footfall, human conspiracy, or claim about the discoverers' conscious intention is established.

epistemic.reason: The trusted publication supplies both focus branch nominations and the focus anchor, while the external row supplies exact Arabic but no target morphology; the stumble facet is therefore explicitly bounded as analogical.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: gizli bir durumu öğrenme veya başkasına bildirme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Gizli ya da önceden bilinmeyen bir durumu, kimi zaman aramadan ve beklenmedik biçimde öğrenip fark etme.
branch_activations.carrier: The Form IV focus carrier at 18:21:2 presents hidden people being brought into knowledge and public notice.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 5:107 supplies a discovery-made-public procedure in which a concealed fault becomes available for public testimony.
branch_activations.activation: The external discovery pattern returns through the focus disclosure carrier, making the hidden sleepers' emergence legible as knowledge transferred into a public dispute.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus disclosure functions as a public making-known of what had been hidden.
branch_activations.boundary: The connection does not supply target morphology and does not decide whether the human encounter was planned.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsanın ya da binek hayvanının yürürken takılması, sendelemesi veya yüzüstü düşmesi.
branch_activations.carrier: The same caused-discovery carrier can carry the appearance of an encounter that stumbles into a hidden matter.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 5:107 supplies the separate image of concealed wrongdoing being found and brought into testimony.
branch_activations.activation: The found-into-public pattern provides the contact for a nonliteral stumble image: an apparently accidental encounter is the route by which disclosure occurs.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The sign can arrive as a seeming stumble while still serving the focus's disclosure function.
branch_activations.boundary: This is not a claim that anyone literally fell or that the Form IV verb has the bare physical-fall sense in isolation.

findings.title: The disclosure is directed through concealment
findings.claim: The Form IV focus carrier presents the hidden sleepers being made known for recognition of the promise, while the preceding concealment and fear context explains why the public encounter can look accidental.
findings.mechanism: The carrier at 18:21:2 returns through the supplied discovery branch; the reader evidence names concealment in 18:19, fear of exposure in 18:20, and 5:107 supplies a wider discovery-to-public-evidence pattern.
findings.reader_payoff: The transition from hiddenness to public evidence becomes a directed change in visibility rather than an unexplained narrative turn.
findings.containment: This remains a legacy reader activation with no independent HFT identity; it does not prove human intention, identify the purpose subject, or activate the physical-stumble branch.

epistemic.reason: The reader source supplies a valid focus branch and contextual sequence, but its identity is legacy-unbound and the external connection lacks target morphology.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: gizli bir durumu öğrenme veya başkasına bildirme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Gizli ya da önceden bilinmeyen bir durumu, kimi zaman aramadan ve beklenmedik biçimde öğrenip fark etme.
branch_activations.carrier: The Form IV focus carrier at 18:21:2 changes the sleepers from concealed persons into an object of public knowing.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied reader evidence names concealment at 18:19, fear of exposure at 18:20, and 5:107 provides a wider found-and-public pattern.
branch_activations.activation: Those separate concealment and discovery pressures contact the focus carrier, making the disclosure read as a directed conversion of hiddenness into public evidence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The apparent accident is held inside a larger movement from deliberate concealment to public recognition.
branch_activations.boundary: The legacy evidence does not establish a named human plan or settle the unexpressed subject of the purpose clause.

findings.title: The affair is pulled into prevailing control
findings.claim: The affair is not only a neutral topic of discussion: reciprocal pulling, factional division, and the later description of those who prevailed make the final proposal an act by the group that has gained control of the matter.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier at 18:21:15 contacts 23:53's parties splitting a common affair, while 18:21:27 and 18:21:29 contact 4:59's direction to return disputed matters rather than leave them to prevailing claimants.
findings.reader_payoff: The final proposal can be perceived as the outcome of a struggle over jurisdiction, not merely the next item in a sequence of opinions.
findings.containment: The external verses are comparative triggers rather than historical identifications; this does not identify the victors, say that they violated 4:59, or adjudicate the proposal's religious status.

epistemic.reason: The supplied branches and connection targets support the carrier-trigger relations, while the HFT affair summary is legacy-unbound and the external target morphology is not supplied.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İki taraf aynı nesne veya mesele üzerinde karşılıklı çekme ve karşı koyma ilişkisine girer.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: 23:53 depicts a common affair being cut into competing party shares.
branch_activations.activation: The wider factional division supplies the separate social image that lets the focus's pulling relation describe the affair as being divided by rival parties.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The dispute is experienced as a struggle that pulls the common affair apart.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch does not determine the parties' identities or turn the physical pulling image into a literal event.

branch_activations.boundary: This does not accuse the focus group of the conduct addressed in 4:59 or settle whether their dominance is legitimate.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam, yönetme yetkisi ve bu yetkiye bağlı makamdır.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The proposed worship site is voiced from a position that claims control over the affair.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch does not replace the ordinary meaning of matter or establish a formal office for the speakers.

findings.title: Adopting the site leaves its institution open
findings.claim: The final phrase joins bringing the sleepers' site into the speakers' control with naming it as a place of prostration; wider mosque evidence keeps devotional designation and contested appropriation visible together.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers at 18:21:30 and 18:21:32 contact 9:107's mosque built for harm and division and 9:108's contrast between a piety-grounded mosque and a site requiring scrutiny, changing the final proposal from bare construction into an institutional claim whose valence remains open.
findings.reader_payoff: The mosque proposal can be read simultaneously as a devotional naming and as an attempt to control the public meaning of the disclosed site.
findings.containment: The focus does not say that its mosque is harmful, pious, forbidden, or equivalent to either external mosque; the wider verses supply comparison and friction, not historical identity.

epistemic.reason: The focus branches and carriers are supplied and the external mosque contrasts are explicit, but the capture synthesis includes legacy-unbound reader evidence and the connection rows lack target morphology.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir nesneye erişme, onu ele geçirme ve kendi denetim alanına alma eylemini anlatır.
branch_activations.carrier: The emphatic Form VIII carrier at 18:21:30 presents the speakers as taking the site for themselves.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 9:107 depicts people taking a mosque as an instrument of harm, disbelief, and division.
branch_activations.activation: The external mosque example supplies a concrete institutional-control image that returns through the focus taking carrier without deciding that the focus speakers share the external motive.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The promise to establish a mosque can also be perceived as an act of adopting the disclosed site into a group's control.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus is not identified with the harmful mosque of 9:107 and the branch does not by itself judge the speakers.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: alnı yere koyma yeri, buna ayrılmış yapı veya küçük yaygı
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kullanım, toplu tapınma için ayrılmış yeri veya bu amaçla kurulmuş yapıyı adlandırır.
branch_activations.carrier: The final masjid noun at 18:21:32 carries the ordinary image of a place or structure set apart for collective prostration.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 9:107 and 9:108 place mosque identity under a contrast between divisive construction and a site grounded in piety.
branch_activations.activation: The wider mosque contrast returns through the focus noun, preserving the worship-space image while making the proposed institution's purpose an unresolved question.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final proposal names a worship institution, but the name alone does not settle whether the institution serves devotion or factional control.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the collective worship-place facet is retained; the focus does not activate the ground-contact, paired-city, or small-rug facets.
